baslik: Why the Ground Suddenly Swallows Houses
hook: The hole that was always there
aciklama:
A sinkhole can swallow a car or a house in seconds - but it was forming underground for centuries. Here is why.

#shorts #science #geology #nature #howitworks

sahneler.metin: Sometimes the ground just opens and swallows a house.
The collapse is sudden, but it was centuries in the making.
Underground, slightly acidic water slowly dissolves soft rock.
Over time it carves out a hidden cavern beneath the surface.
The soil on top keeps the ground looking completely normal.
But the cavern keeps growing, and the roof gets thinner.
When it can no longer hold the weight, everything drops at once.
Rain and burst pipes can speed the collapse dramatically.
The hole did not appear - it was always waiting.
